company.name: Laminar
company.shortDescription: Laminar is a decentralized financial platform.
company.description: Laminar is developing an open finance platform that will power synthetic assets and margin trading. They launch Flowchain with Substrate to scale it up to a performance trading chain. As a Polkadot ecosystem partner, Flowchain will contribute to and leverage this interoperable and scalable network of blockchain ecosystems.
